Name: Community Center Randomizer - Redux
Author: PandaPal312
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]A randomizer for the community center, for both bundles and the rewards you can get! There are two forms of randomization, toggleable in GMCM, themed randomization, which randomizes the contents of each room while sticking to a theme. (i.e. only fish-related items in the Fish Tank) or true random, for some complete madness! This is meant to make the community center more of a challenge and a fresh experience for those of us that have completed it a bunch of times.[/color][/size]

Also, this is my first time making a mod, so apologies in advance for any issues that may arise. I will do my best to squash any bugs ASAP.

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Simply unzip and put the folder in your mods folder.[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8][b]Randomization of bundles:[/b] from a pool of over 400 items, the requirements for each bundle are selected at random, with some limitations to ensure late game items aren't required in the early game. The vault's bundles remain unchanged as the game *really* does not like changing the amounts of gold, but this is something I hope to crack someday.
[b]Randomization of rewards:[/b] every reward is a gamble! You might get a single piece of wood, or you might get a late game item from the island, there is only one way to find out which! The pool of 150+ rewards is also divided so that late game items don't appear too early. Even the vault's rewards are randomized![/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Only requirement is SMAPI, but GMCM is nice for switching randomization mode.
This mod won't work on old saves, so be sure to have the mod installed and to choose your randomization mode before making a new save. Make sure to only use Normal bundles when making a new save file, as this bundle hasn't been tested with remixed.[/size][/color]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Major shoutout to BowToChris/ThePaladinTheo for the creation of Community Center Bundles Randomizer[/color], which gave me the inspiration and groundwork for this mod.
